dimensions.description: Verify tools.discover recommends the expected toolchain from sample profile metadata.
dimensions.default_ci_metric: expected recommended_tools and plugin_ids are present in the portal result
dimensions.residual_gap_policy: Record missing live-tool coverage as residual_gaps instead of requiring heavy backends in CI.

dimensions.description: Track whether the profile routes toward function inventory, disassembly, and decompilation tools.
dimensions.default_ci_metric: function recovery tools are recommended for synthetic native profiles
dimensions.residual_gap_policy: Runtime equivalence and source-level scoring require an opt-in external corpus.

dimensions.description: Track routing toward multiple decompiler or IR backends for consensus review.
dimensions.default_ci_metric: consensus-capable tools are recommended and backend profile gates are visible
dimensions.residual_gap_policy: Cross-backend output comparison is recorded as a residual gap unless real backends are enabled.

dimensions.description: Track routing toward string extraction, decoder, and malware configuration recovery paths.
dimensions.default_ci_metric: string and config recovery tools are present in recommendations
dimensions.residual_gap_policy: Family-specific config parsing stays opt-in and corpus-backed.

dimensions.description: Track static JavaScript obfuscation, simplification, and JSVMP routing without executing JavaScript.
dimensions.default_ci_metric: passive JS deobfuscation tools are recommended for JavaScript profiles
dimensions.residual_gap_policy: Dynamic JavaScript execution and browser/V8 traces remain outside default CI.

dimensions.description: Verify recommendations preserve readiness, profile, BYO, sidecar, and runtime gates.
dimensions.default_ci_metric: expected readiness_state and backend safety_gate values are present
dimensions.residual_gap_policy: Real backend startup and sandbox execution are never required by default.

cases.profile: tiny PE metadata with imports, strings, and function recovery intent
residual_gaps: Function recovery is represented by metadata routing; no binary is decompiled in default CI.
String/config accuracy needs corpus-backed output comparison outside the guard suite.

cases.profile: packed PE metadata that should route to unpacking plus multiple decompiler backends
residual_gaps: Consensus compares expected routing only; real Ghidra/RetDec output equivalence is external-corpus gated.
Packed payload extraction is not executed in default CI.

cases.profile: .NET PE metadata with strings and configuration extraction intent
residual_gaps: The case validates routing to config tooling but does not assert malware family parsers.

cases.profile: JavaScript artifact metadata with obfuscation and VM bytecode signals
residual_gaps: Tiny fixture mode only covers static metadata and does not execute JavaScript.
JSVMP handler-map quality needs corpus-backed AST/IR comparison.

cases.profile: PE profile requesting dynamic behavior collection and readiness planning
residual_gaps: Runtime behavior collection is represented by readiness metadata only.
Host execution and live sample execution remain disallowed in default CI.

cases.profile: Optional educational crackme corpus with executable oracle scoring

external_corpus.description: Optional educational crackme corpus; not downloaded or executed by default CI.

residual_gaps: Executable oracle scoring is opt-in and must run in an isolated no-network sandbox.
